fresh_saved_wrench_normalization.method: Recompute lift=-sin(alpha)Fx+cos(alpha)Fz; drag=cos(alpha)Fx+sin(alpha)Fz; CL=lift/qS, CD=drag/qS, Cm=My/(qS*Cref), using only saved wrench/reference/settings.
fresh_saved_wrench_normalization.limit: Saved worker packets omit individual strip loads, physical circulation and full drag components, so this is normalization evidence, not independent reconstruction of strip aggregation or of the aerodynamic operator.

fourier_evidence.fresh_baseline_representation: pointwise, one independent circulation unknown per lifting interval (200 or 400); circulation_method=auto selects the numerical solve route, not Fourier count

references.claim: OPER K opens option selection. Its I command sets the maximum Newton iterations per operating point. Thus the original OPER/K/I/100 sequence is not a Fourier-count setting.

NODE shows beam nodes and minimum/maximum Fourier signals. The illustrated Wing has 180 nodes and k=1 to k=19, explicitly described as this case. The caption does not declare a universal default or a rule deriving K from NODE I.

The published formulation admits pointwise circulation per structural interval or a K-term sine series. The number of Fourier modes can be smaller than the number of structural intervals. K and structural resolution are distinct discretization choices.

For K<I-1, tangency is imposed as weighted residuals rather than exact local satisfaction at every interval. Matching a converged pointwise calculation does not establish equality to a historically truncated Fourier system.
Release notes say default circulation-mode settings when LOADing a new geometry were fixed. They give no numerical count or NODE I update rule, and are not a retained SA1 v5.96 startup-state record.
The report explains that finite Fourier circulation decouples aerodynamic unknown count from the structural/horseshoe mesh.

The authors recommend 20 to 40 circulation variables/Fourier coefficients from an elliptical-wing convergence study. This recommendation is not an explicit SA1 driver setting or a documented ASWING default.
The frozen SA1 worker constructs FlightCondition without circulation_modes and passes circulation_method=auto to the rigid solver.
FlightCondition circulation_modes defaults to an empty map, documented as pointwise for omitted beams.
The default empty mode map creates one circulation unknown per interval and identity sample/test operators; a positive explicit beam count selects Fourier sine sampling/test operators.

limits: No retained SA1 .set file, startup NODE menu listing or v5.96 implementation source has been established by this bounded audit.
The available guide/manual/theory passages do not prove that NODE I200 leaves K unchanged, resets K, or sets K=200. The update rule remains unresolved.
Do not select Fourier K by the archived numerical match count or call the manual example/report recommendation the historical SA1 default.
fourier_evidence.actionable_next_step: Recover an original v5.96 NODE/default implementation, retained SA1 settings or an original menu transcript to establish the independent K/default/update rule. Any prospectively declared Fourier-vs-pointwise source-operator study must remain a discretization diagnostic rather than a recovered historical setup.

interpretation: The fresh current-kernel baseline reproduces the previous 19/154 match count and the entire mismatch trend to floating-point roundoff. Later point-object/sensor kernel changes did not resolve SA1 under these unchanged baseline settings.
Current 200-to-400 interval refinement does not test an unknown historical truncated Fourier count. Its small mesh delta therefore cannot by itself exclude a circulation-representation mismatch.
The preserved original 11 rows and all seven printed channels remain the acceptance targets; no parameter, source token, gate or match definition was changed by this audit.
